steps: Wash the rice and moong dal and soak them for 15 to 20 minutes, then drain.
Chop the carrot and beans very small.
Put the rice, dal, vegetables, turmeric and about 300 ml water a child in a pressure cooker.
Cook on medium for 3 to 4 whistles, then let the pressure drop on its own.
Heat the ghee in a small pan on low, add the cumin, let it crackle, then stir in the hing.
Pour this over the khichdi and mash it soft, adding a little hot water if it is too thick.
Cool until just warm before serving.
note: No salt. Chicken is minced and cooked with the rice and dal so it turns soft; egg and paneer go in at the end.
